sentences.en: It is foolish of you to believe such a thing.
sentences.zh: 相信这种事情真是愚蠢。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the foolish uncle was sitting in the living room.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，那个愚蠢的叔叔正坐在客厅里。

sentences.en: It is foolish of him to pay for it again.
sentences.zh: 他再次为此付款真是太傻了。

senses.zh: 愚蠢的,鲁莽的,荒谬的，可笑的,混
